Behind the track are large, rusted metal wheels and gears, part of the drive mechanism. The background is cluttered with indistinct mechanical parts and debris. The scene appears outdoors or in an open shed, with earthy tones and significant wear.

The wood grain on the conveyor slats is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine fibrous detail expected of rough industrial timber. The edges of the slats bleed slightly into the gaps.
The parallel lines of the conveyor track warp slightly and do not converge consistently towards a vanishing point, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation.
